descriptions.sendNow: Emails go out in batches starting on the next dispatch run. This cannot be undone once messages leave.
descriptions.pause: Sending stops between batches. Recipients already emailed are unaffected.
descriptions.resume: Sending continues from where it stopped. Nobody is emailed twice.
descriptions.cancel: The campaign stops for good and no further emails are sent. Messages already delivered stay delivered.

audience.failed: The audience could not be resolved.
audience.empty: Nobody would receive this campaign. Check the audience before sending.
